value.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) & Cloud Metadata Defense Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_ssrf", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "ssrf", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)", "name": "Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) & Cloud Metadata Defense Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-918", "owasp_category": "A10:2021 - Server-Side Request Forgery", "signals": ["url_parameter_input", "webhook_creation_endpoint", "image_fetch_from_url", "pdf_generator_url_parameter", "proxy_forwarding_parameter"], "verification_strategy": "Test input parameters accepting URLs against loopback variations (127.0.0.1, 2130706433, [::1], 127.1), cloud metadata representations (169.254.169.254, 0xA9FEA9FE), and alternative URI schemes. Validate if the server follows redirects to internal network addresses.", "evidence_requirements": ["internal_service_response_banner", "response_timing_differential", "cloud_metadata_token_signature"], "tools": [{"tool": "SSRFSkill", "cmd": "SSRFSkill.run(url, param)", "desc": "Multi-tier IP encoding & cloud metadata matrix probe"}, {"tool": "SSRFFilterBypasser", "cmd": "SSRFFilterBypasser.get_all_bypasses('http://127.0.0.1/admin')", "desc": "Generates 15+ canonical IP representations (decimal, octal, hex, DNS rebinding)"}], "remediation": "Enforce strict allowlists of permissible target domains and IP ranges. Explicitly drop connections to RFC 1918 private subnets and link-local 169.254.169.254. Disable following redirects, and resolve DNS once before connecting (preventing DNS rebinding).", "description": "PortSwigger SSRF labs investigate basic SSRF against local administrative interfaces, SSRF bypassing blacklist filters using alternative IP encodings, whitelist filter bypasses using URL credentials (@), and SSRF via Open Redirection."}
